safePurpose: Compare clinic-provided appointment, sample and result-follow-up calendar dates with a planning date and user-marked logistical status.
privacy: Treat dates and logistical status as highly sensitive. Do not request medicine, regimen, dose, missed-dose, adherence, clinic, patient or contact details and do not retain, log, upload, sync, email, network-send, add entries to accounts or URLs, or send them to analytics.
disallowed: asking medicine, regimen, dose, missed-dose or adherence details
inferring diagnosis, treatment response, infectiousness or medicine use from dates or status
treating a user-marked completed status as proof of attendance or adherence
staticText: Private TB Clinic Date Tracker for /tools/tb-tracker/. Explain only whole-day comparisons among the planning date and clinic-provided appointment, sample and result-follow-up dates, together with user-marked logistical status: scheduled, marked completed, or changed by the clinic. Flag a past scheduled date, a future date marked completed, or a same-episode result date earlier than its sample date for clinic confirmation. A completed status is a local logistical note, never proof of attendance, medicine use or adherence. Do not ask medicine, regimen, dose, missed-dose or adherence details; give treatment advice; infer diagnosis, treatment response, treatment failure or infectiousness from dates; or set clinical timing. Treat all dates and statuses as highly sensitive and local: do not retain, log, upload, sync, email, network-send, add them to accounts or URLs, or send them to analytics. Source reviewed 2026-07-26: WHO Tuberculosis fact sheet (24 March 2026).
